text: Compare the Samsung Galaxy S25 and the iPhone 16 (base models) in a new online spreadsheet at https://ethercalc.net. Take the facts from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_Galaxy_S25 and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_16: release date, display size (inches), weight (g), battery (mAh) and base storage (GB). Put one row per fact with a column for each phone, and a Difference column that uses formulas (Samsung minus iPhone) for the numeric rows. Tell me the spreadsheet's link.
